title: Drone attack targets Moscow, prompting airport restrictions
summary: Drones attacked the Russian capital and the Moscow region. Two planes flying from Turkey to Moscow were diverted due to restrictions at Vnukovo Airport.

title: Military personnel can order NRK amphibious vehicles through Brave1 Market
summary: A new class of ground-based robotic systems—amphibious ground-based robotic systems—is now available on the Brave1 Market platform for the military.

title: Germany and Japan reaffirm commitment to continued support for Ukraine
summary: Germany and Japan have reaffirmed their commitment to continuing support for Ukraine and working closely together to achieve a just and lasting peace.

title: UN to provide winter assistance to 2.1 million Ukrainians
summary: The United Nations plans to provide winter assistance to 2.1 million Ukrainians from October 26, 2026, through March 2027, with about 84% of the aid earmarked for people living within 50 kilometers of the front line.

title: Demining underway along civilian evacuation routes from Oleshky to Lubinets
summary: Demining operations are currently underway along the routes used by civilians to leave the city of Oleshky in the Kherson region.

title: Two State Emergency Service bomb disposal experts killed during demining operation in Sumy region
summary: On October 28, in the Sumy region, two employees of the State Emergency Service of Ukraine were killed during a humanitarian demining operation.

title: Russia holds captive journalists in inhumane conditions, subjects them to torture – Lubinets
summary: Russian occupying forces are deliberately torturing Ukrainian journalists held in captivity and subjecting them to inhumane conditions.

title: New taxes in Russia fuel tensions between Kremlin and big business – intelligence
summary: Russian businesses are demanding a review of tax changes amid concerns over declining investment and capital outflows.

title: Ukraine's parliament calls on world not to recognize Russia's State Duma 'elections'
summary: The Verkhovna Rada has adopted a resolution calling on the international community not to recognize the legitimacy of elections to the ninth convocation of Russia's State Duma or their results.

title: Ex-judge sentenced to nine years in prison over fatal checkpoint crash
summary: Kyiv's Sviatoshynskyi District Court has found a former judge guilty of violating traffic safety rules, resulting in the death of a 22-year-old serviceman, and sentenced him to nine years in prison.

title: National Bank raises key policy rate to 16.5%
summary: The National Bank of Ukraine has raised its key policy rate to 16.5%.

title: Death toll from Russian attack on Kremenchuk rises to three, 15 injured
summary: A Russian drone struck a high-rise residential building in Kremenchuk, Poltava region, killing three people and injuring 15 others.

title: Russian drone attack on central Chernihiv kills two teenage girls, injures 11
summary: Two people were killed and 11 others injured in a drone attack on central Chernihiv.

title: Ukrainian forces strike Russian drone depots, fuel storage site, drone launch site
summary: On October 28 and overnight into October 29, Ukraine's Defense Forces struck a drone storage facility, a drone launch site and a fuel depot belonging to the Russian army near Navlya in Russia's Bryansk region.

title: Two dead as Russian drone hits apartment building in Kremenchuk
summary: A Russian drone has struck an apartment building in Kremenchuk, Poltava region, killing two people and injuring one.

title: Poland to transfer two more MiG-29 fighter jets to Ukraine
summary: Poland will soon transfer two more MiG-29 fighter jets to Ukraine as part of a new military aid package worth around EUR 50 million. The package will also include ammunition and air defense equipment.

title: Ukraine needs EU support to develop decentralized power generation – Kachka
summary: Ukraine needs support from the European Union to develop decentralized power generation, which would help ensure independent power supplies for residential buildings and keep businesses operating amid Russian attacks.

title: Russian attack on Dnipro railway station kills at least 13, injures 13
summary: Russian forces have attacked the railway station in Dnipro, killing at least 13 people. The number of those injured is not yet known.

title: No ceasefire violations in Oleshky, humanitarian aid delivery planned for Friday – Lubinets
summary: Ukrainian Human Rights Commissioner Dmytro Lubinets has announced that a humanitarian shipment is being prepared for residents of Oleshky.

title: Ukraine will drive European security even without near-term NATO membership – Chentsov
summary: At this stage, Ukraine is thinking more in terms of partnership with NATO than membership, while seeking to join the EU as a factor in security on the continent.

title: Ukrainian delegation heads toward Russian-occupied Oleshky – Arakhamia
summary: A Ukrainian delegation led by Ukrainian Human Rights Commissioner Dmytro Lubinets set off today toward the temporarily occupied city of Oleshky in the Kherson region, where it will monitor the humanitarian operation.

title: Russian FPV drone strikes bus in central Zaporizhzhia, injuring four
summary: Russian forces attacked a bus approaching a bus stop in central Zaporizhzhia with an FPV drone, injuring four people.

title: Investing in conventional weapons better than developing nuclear program of one's own – expert
summary: The best security guarantees are membership in the North Atlantic Alliance or, at the very least, protection under a "nuclear umbrella," while possessing nuclear weapons of one's own is too expensive and dangerous.

title: Drones target one of Russia’s largest chemical complexes in Bashkortostan, media report
summary: On Thursday morning, October 29, drones attacked one of Russia’s largest chemical complexes in Bashkortostan, which manufactures products for the defense industry.

title: Defense forces repel 42 attacks in Pokrovsk sector as 189 clashes reported along front line in past 24 hours
summary: Over the past 24 hours, on October 28, 189 combat engagements between the Ukrainian Defense Forces and Russian invaders were recorded on the front lines, with the enemy exerting the most pressure in the Pokrovsk direction.

title: Russian forces launch nearly 20 attacks on Dnipropetrovsk region since evening, injuring one person
summary: Since this evening, Russian forces have launched nearly 20 drone attacks on Dnipro and the Dnipropetrovsk region; one man was injured.

title: Russia loses another 1,560 troops in war against Ukraine in past 24 hours
summary: Total combat losses among Russian troops since the start of the full-scale invasion of Ukraine—from February 24, 2022, to October 29, 2026—amount to approximately 1,584,910 personnel, including 1,560 over the past 24 hours.

title: Azov has struck more than 100 Russian trains in Donetsk region
summary: Soldiers of the 1st Corps of the Ukrainian National Guard “Azov” struck more than 100 Russian trains carrying fuel and other supplies in the Donetsk region.

title: Russian forces strike educational institution in Kharkiv
summary: The Russians launched drone strikes on the Kholodnogorsk and Saltiv districts of Kharkiv.

title: Ukraine seeks to expand participation in special tribunal on Russian aggression, Karasevych says
summary: Ukraine is working to expand the geographic representation of states in the special tribunal on Russia’s crime of aggression.
